_note: Teardown/breakdown data for the Showroom's exploded view. Anchors are in FITTED car space (the model is auto-fit to ~3.4 units long, grounded at y=0, +X nose, +Y up, +Z left) — the same frame as frontend/src/lib/systems.js hotspots. `materials` are GLB material-name substrings the frontend matches to select each part's meshes for highlight/explode (empty = not modeled in this GLB; show as an info callout at the anchor). `explode` is a unit-ish direction hint for the exploded layout. Part copy is grounded on data/cars/44-honda-civic-si-10th.json (systems_map + web-verified specs); anchors computed by frontend/scripts/model_meshes.mjs with the sibling .partmap.json.

parts.label: 1.5L L15B7 Turbo Engine
parts.summary: The turbocharged heart — a 1.5-liter direct-injected four that gives the Si its broad, flexible pull.
parts.detail: 1.5L L15B7 turbocharged, direct-injected four — 205 hp and a broad 192 lb-ft plateau from just 2,100 rpm out to 5,000. Fundamentally robust and famously responsive to tuning.
parts.watch: Oil dilution — fuel washing into the crankcase during short, cold-weather trips — is THE watch item on the 1.5T family. Check the oil level, let it warm up before hard driving, and don't stretch changes in winter.

parts.label: 6-Speed Manual & Helical LSD
parts.summary: A short-throw six-speed sending everything to the front wheels through a limited-slip differential.
parts.detail: 6-speed manual driving the front wheels through a helical limited-slip differential — the LSD plus the turbo's low-end torque make it easy to drive quickly.
parts.watch: The turbo hardware is durable; most trouble traces to maintenance, not parts. Clutch wear shows up on tuned or hard-driven cars.

parts.label: Suspension & Adaptive Dampers
parts.summary: Struts up front, multi-link rear, and the first adaptive dampers Honda ever put on a Civic.
parts.detail: MacPherson strut front and independent multi-link rear on an ultra-rigid subframe, with an Adaptive Damper System (ADS) — the first application of adaptive dampers on any Civic.
parts.watch: The adaptive dampers make lowering trickier — you need springs or coilovers designed to keep the ADS happy or it throws a warning. Refresh bushings on high-mile cars.

parts.label: Four-Wheel Disc Brakes
parts.summary: Discs at all four corners, sized up over the base Civic to match the Si's pace.
parts.detail: Four-wheel discs, larger than the base Civic's, matched to the Si's grip and pace.
parts.watch: Pads and fluid wear faster with sport driving — inspect and refresh them more often than on a commuter.

parts.label: 18" Wheels & Tires
parts.summary: Eighteen-inch alloys on wide, sticky rubber — the grip the LSD chassis is built to use.
parts.detail: Factory 18×8-inch alloy wheels on 235/40R18 tires. The Si's wider, grippier setup (vs. the base Civic) is what feeds the helical LSD and the adaptive-damper chassis.
parts.watch: Curb rash and pothole damage on the low-profile 18s; summer performance tires wake the car up but wear faster.

parts.label: Body, Aero & Glass
parts.summary: The steel unibody — the last Civic Si coupe Honda built — with the Si's aggressive fascias and spoiler.
parts.detail: Steel unibody as the FC3 coupe (the last Civic Si coupe Honda made), around 2,906 lbs, with the Si's more aggressive front and rear fascias, side sills, and a decklid spoiler. (This particular model also wears an added carbon front lip.)
parts.watch: Solid structure; watch for rock chips and parking dings like any daily-driven compact.

parts.label: Lighting & Electronics
parts.summary: Full-LED lighting and the Si's touchscreen electrical suite.
parts.detail: LED headlights and taillights, plus Honda's era touchscreen infotainment and the usual Civic accessory systems.
parts.watch: The pre-refresh head unit could be laggy and infamously dropped the physical volume knob for a touch slider. A/C compressor failures are a known complaint of this Honda era.

parts.label: Interior & Driver's Cockpit
parts.summary: Bolstered sport seats, a digital cluster, and the driver-focused Si cockpit.
parts.detail: Bolstered Si sport seats with red contrast stitching, a digital/analog instrument cluster, and the 6-speed shifter. (This model adds an aftermarket OMP steering wheel and racing seat.)
parts.watch: Seat-bolster wear on hard-used cars; the pre-refresh infotainment could lag.
